notes: 不用 Fable 系列（太贵）。effort 暂定 high，维护者可改。
公平条件（时间上限、CPU、内存、GPU、联网屏蔽）对所有条件相同，见 src/researchworld_eval/container/defaults.toml 的 [conditions]。

Codex 条件经 codex-api 使用项目自己的 ChatGPT（Codex）登录；先 `providers codex-api start`。被测系统和判官用不同账号：被测系统的 Codex worker 用 `codex-jack`（条件的 `credentials: {codex: codex-jack}`），RW-sol 的 Codex 岗位由 HuTian 直接读 `codex-jack` 账号的独立登录 `codex-jack-rw`（可按运行改选 `codex-jacques-rw`），判官用 `codex-jacques`（codex-api 的 `default_account`），`codex-zeyuan` 只供显式选择，其余旧账号已退役。HuTian 直接读的登录不能和同账号的 codex-api 服务共用一个（刷新令牌只能用一次），所以 RW 读同账号的独立登录：RW-sol 可以和经 codex-api 用 `codex-jack` 的条件同时运行，只共用用量额度。

Claude Code 类系统（CC、AS-opus、AS-sonnet）用 Claude 订阅的 setup token，记录里按价目表折算、不计实际花费；ResearchWorld 用项目自己的登录，每次运行用 `--credential CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN=<NAME>` 选具名 token（运行侧只用 JIEKE 和 JACQUES，优先级 JIEKE > JACQUES；JACK 只给判官；ZEYUAN 的 token 已撤销，2026-11-12 起不用），额度用完的运行 `stop` 后用 `resume --credential CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN=<NAME>` 换另一个。CC 和 AS 条件默认写 JIEKE，运行时用 `--credential anthropic=<具名变量>` 改选 JACQUES；JIEKE 和 JACQUES 都没有额度时才可以显式用 JACK，须加 `--allow-judge-token 原因`，会和判官共用额度。ARC 和 EVO 自己调 Messages API，订阅 token 不适用：sonnet 条件经本机 sub2api（Anthropic 兼容，背后是 Claude 订阅，凭据 SUB2API_KEY_ANTHROPIC，服务地址在被忽略的 .project/sub2api.toml），ARC-opus 用 ANTHROPIC_PROMO_API_KEY（余额约 25 美元），EVO-opus 指向的 ANTHROPIC_PROMO_API_KEY_2 已无余额，由维护者另行决定。
notes_en: No Fable models (too expensive). Effort is high for now; the maintainer may change it.
The fair conditions (time limit, CPU, memory, GPU, network shield) are the same for every condition, see [conditions] in src/researchworld_eval/container/defaults.toml.

The Codex conditions use the project's own ChatGPT (Codex) login through codex-api; run `providers codex-api start` first. The systems under test and the judges use different accounts: the systems under test's Codex workers use `codex-jack` (a condition's `credentials: {codex: codex-jack}`), the Codex roles of RW-sol are served by HuTian reading `codex-jack-rw`, an independent login of the `codex-jack` account, directly (or `codex-jacques-rw` when chosen per run), the judges use `codex-jacques` (codex-api's `default_account`), `codex-zeyuan` is for explicit selection only, and the older accounts are retired. A login HuTian reads directly cannot be shared with the codex-api server of the same account (the refresh token is single-use), so RW reads an independent sign-in of the same account: RW-sol can run at the same time as the conditions that use `codex-jack` through codex-api, and they only share the usage allowance.

The Claude Code systems (CC, AS-opus, AS-sonnet) use a Claude subscription setup token; records show a list-price equivalent, not an actual charge. ResearchWorld uses the project's own login and picks a named token per run with `--credential CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN=<NAME>` (runs use only JIEKE and JACQUES, in the order JIEKE > JACQUES; JACK serves the judges only; ZEYUAN has not been used since 2026-11-12, its token was revoked); a run whose allowance is used up is `stop`ped and switched to another with `resume --credential CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN=<NAME>`. The CC and AS conditions default to JIEKE and take another named token per run with `--credential anthropic=<NAME>` (JACQUES); JACK may be used explicitly only when neither JIEKE nor JACQUES has allowance left, with `--allow-judge-token REASON`, and then share the allowance with the judges. ARC and EVO call the Messages API themselves, so a subscription token does not apply: their sonnet conditions go through the local sub2api (Anthropic-compatible, on a Claude subscription; credential SUB2API_KEY_ANTHROPIC; the service address is in the ignored .project/sub2api.toml), ARC-opus uses ANTHROPIC_PROMO_API_KEY (about 25 USD of balance), and EVO-opus points at ANTHROPIC_PROMO_API_KEY_2, whose balance is gone; the maintainer decides that separately.

items.name: RW-sol
items.description: ResearchWorld：E2E 任务用全部岗位（HuTian v4.9 起 8 个，v4.8.2 及更早 9 个）；benchmark 题目按 HuTian 官方 benchmark 设置选岗位；所有岗位同一模型（Codex）
items.description_en: ResearchWorld: all roles for E2E tasks (8 since HuTian v4.9, 9 on v4.8.2 and earlier); benchmark items take the roles of HuTian's own benchmark settings; the same model (Codex) in every role
items.notes: 所有岗位用 HuTian 现有的 Codex worker，gpt-6.1-sol、effort high，和 CX-sol 同模型同档 effort，成对比较“RW 用 Codex 能不能超过单个 Codex agent”。Codex 岗位直接用项目自己的 Codex 登录（HuTian 的 HT_CODEX_AUTH_FILE，不经 codex-api：HuTian 的强制代理只放行官方端点）：默认 `codex-jack` 账号的 `codex-jack-rw`（和经 codex-api 用 `codex-jack` 的条件共用额度），可按运行改选 `codex-jacques-rw`（和判官共用额度）；判官用 `codex-jacques`。和经 codex-api 用 `codex-jack` 的 CX-sol、AS-sol、EVO-sol 可以同时运行，只共用账号的用量额度（preflight 在同一批次里两者并存时打印 note）；RW-sol 和 RW-mixed 的 Codex 岗位读同一个登录文件，由 HuTian 自己的锁串行刷新。RW-astra 和混合版暂不加。
items.notes_en: Every role uses HuTian's existing Codex worker, gpt-6.1-sol at effort high, the same model and effort as CX-sol for a paired comparison of whether RW with Codex can beat a single Codex agent. The Codex roles use the project's own Codex login directly (HuTian's HT_CODEX_AUTH_FILE, not through codex-api: HuTian's mandatory proxy admits only the official endpoints): by default `codex-jack-rw` of the `codex-jack` account (sharing the allowance with the conditions that use `codex-jack` through codex-api), or `codex-jacques-rw` when chosen per run (sharing the allowance with the judges); the judges use `codex-jacques`. RW-sol can run at the same time as CX-sol, AS-sol and EVO-sol, which use `codex-jack` through codex-api, and they only share the account's usage allowance (preflight prints a note when a batch holds both); RW-sol and the Codex roles of RW-mixed read the same login file, and HuTian's own lock serialises their refreshes. RW-astra and a mixed variant are not added for now.

preinstalled.zh: 编排镜像：上游代码（固定提交、未改）、uv 锁定依赖、docker CLI（经 shim 给兄弟容器加代理和 CA）；agent 镜像：上游自己的 agent-cli Dockerfile
preinstalled.en: orchestrator image: upstream code at the pin (unmodified), uv-locked dependencies, the docker CLI (a shim adds proxy and CA to sibling containers); agent image: upstream's own agent-cli Dockerfile

notes.benchmark_paths: A benchmark item's paths are mounted into the agent containers unless upstream mounts the same path itself (/workspace and below, /home/agent-home, /task-source, /run, /tmp): those are left out and listed in logs/sibling-mounts.txt. The agents work in upstream's own /workspace (the run directory), so a deliverable the official prompt names under such a path is not written where the run collects it.
notes.venue: paper.paper_format=iclr for every task. The system has only iclr and alife specs and does not choose a venue itself; ICML and NeurIPS templates and a system-chosen venue are unsupported.
notes.task_input: Only the `# Goal` and `# Rubrics` sections of task.md are read: all five candidate files are put under `# Goal` with their headings turned into bold lines; `# Rubrics` carries a neutral line. The paradigm is optimisation of a scalar score: the task-drafting phase (documented as experimental) turns the brief into an evaluator and a seed program.
notes.phases: execution.phases=task_drafting,investigation,final_evaluation,paper; the system's own default also runs ablations and posthoc; final_evaluation stays because a drafted task requires it before the paper. review/revision (second model) are never selected.
notes.agent_pool: agent.pool and agent.models.* are left empty: one model for every phase.
notes.second_provider: No OPENAI/GEMINI key is supplied (concept figures stay in deterministic export mode).
notes.time: No global wall-clock or token cap exists upstream; the runner enforces time_limit_hours. Native caps used: idea cycles=3, per-phase timeouts from [systems.agentic-scientist].
notes.network: Sibling agent containers run on the shield's internal network; the agents keep their CLI WebFetch/Bash network, which go through the shield. Provider hosts are only tunnelled by the shield.
notes.concept_figure: Upstream starts the container of its concept-figure step on Docker's default network and removes the proxy variables inside it. The docker shim starts it on the shield's internal network like every other sibling, and the figure tool starts its agent through a launcher (/rwe/concept-launcher.sh, named by AUTOILLUSTRATE_HEADLESS_BIN) that puts the shield's variables back, so the step's model calls go through the shield (Issues #420, #421; runs before that change made them past the shield, and the Codex condition's step failed).
notes.search: Provider server-side web search is switched off in every sibling by the agent CLIs' own system settings, bind-mounted read-only by the docker shim: Claude Code /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json (permissions.deny WebSearch), Codex /etc/codex/config.toml (web_search="disabled") and /etc/codex/requirements.toml (allowed_web_search_modes=["disabled"]). Upstream's own Semantic Scholar client goes through the shield.
notes.key_exposure: The provider key is in the environment of the agent containers (upstream env-file mechanism) and therefore visible to commands the agent runs. Claude Code's CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1 was tried and aborts: it needs bubblewrap, which the unmodified upstream agent image lacks.
notes.runtime_dependencies: The container that installs a drafted task's pinned requirements (upstream's runtime bootstrap, `pip install --only-binary=:all:` with no index option) gets PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL=https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu for a condition without a GPU, so a `+cpu` PyTorch pin the model chose resolves; no other container gets it.
notes.gpu: gpus=1 is wired (container.gpu_count, harness GPU evaluation) but was not exercised.
notes.docker_socket: The orchestrator has its run's private docker socket; the privileged daemon is root-equivalent.

items.name: AS-sol
items.notes: 阶段一的 GPT-6.1 Sol 列。上游的 Codex 兄弟 agent（Headless 经 `codex exec --model`、`-c model_reasoning_effort` 调用）经 codex-api 用 `codex-jack`：适配层只在兄弟容器的系统级 /etc/codex/config.toml 里加一个指向 codex-api 的自定义 provider（Responses API），占位 key 由 docker 垫片给兄弟容器，联网屏蔽代理换成本机 key。上游的提示、阶段和算法不变。特殊情况（维护者 2026-11-13，#351）：只有 t07 这一题的运行多拿到一份只读数据 `t07-open-llm-leaderboard-columns`（得分矩阵每一列是哪道原题、每一行是哪个模型），见 plan.extra_resources；这个条件的其他题和其他条件都没有。已知问题（#420，2026-11-17）：2026-11-17 之前的 10 个 e2e-formal 运行，论文的图 1（概念图）是空白的占位图。原因在我们的接入，不是上游的缺陷：画图的容器没有接到运行的网络上，也没拿到占位 key，一次模型请求都没发出去。修好（#422）后这 10 题重跑；重跑的结果出来之前，这些运行的直接比较结果带着这个问题。
items.notes_en: The GPT-6.1 Sol column of phase 1. Upstream's Codex sibling agent (Headless calls `codex exec --model` with `-c model_reasoning_effort`) uses `codex-jack` through codex-api: the adapter only adds a custom provider pointing at codex-api (Responses API) to the siblings' system-level /etc/codex/config.toml; the docker shim gives the siblings a placeholder key and the shield proxy swaps in the local key. Upstream's prompts, phases and algorithm are unchanged. Special case (maintainer, 2026-11-13, #351): only the runs of task t07 are given one more read-only piece of data, `t07-open-llm-leaderboard-columns` (which question each column of the score matrices is and which model each row is), see plan.extra_resources; no other task of this condition and no other condition has it. Known problem (#420, 2026-11-17): in the 10 e2e-formal runs made before 2026-11-17 the paper's Figure 1 (the concept figure) is a blank placeholder. The cause is in our integration, not an upstream defect: the figure-rendering container was not on the run's network and was given no placeholder key, so it sent no model request at all. With the fix (#422) the 10 tasks are run again; until those results are in, these runs' direct comparison results carry the problem.

items.notes: 维护者 2026-11-02 定（#193）：模型调用经本机 sub2api 服务（Anthropic 兼容，背后是 Claude 订阅），不再用已无余额的 ANTHROPIC_PROMO_API_KEY_2。条件里 provider 仍是 anthropic（EvoScientist 原生的 Anthropic provider，只多一个 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL）；路线由凭据变量名 SUB2API_KEY_ANTHROPIC 决定。提示和算法不变；容器里 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY 只是占位符，联网屏蔽代理持有 key 和服务地址。
items.notes_en: Maintainer, 2026-11-02 (#193): model calls go through the local sub2api service (Anthropic-compatible, on a Claude subscription) instead of ANTHROPIC_PROMO_API_KEY_2, whose balance is gone. The condition's provider stays anthropic (EvoScientist's native Anthropic provider with one extra ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL); the route follows the credential variable SUB2API_KEY_ANTHROPIC. Prompts and algorithm are unchanged; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the container is a placeholder, the shield proxy holds the key and the service's address.

preinstalled.zh: 上游锁定依赖（uv sync --frozen）加兼容补丁 compat.patch；TeX Live（含 fonts-extra、latexmk）；给 agent 用的研究 Python 环境 /opt/research
preinstalled.en: upstream's locked dependencies (uv sync --frozen) plus compat.patch; TeX Live (with fonts-extra and latexmk); a research Python environment for the agent in /opt/research

notes.agent: No external coding agent: EvoScientist runs its own in-process planner/research/code/debug/writing sub-agents (LangChain deepagents) on the one configured model. conditions.agent only selects the provider; Claude Code and Codex are not used.
notes.model: Main agent, sub-agents and EvoScientist's auxiliary calls (tool selector, memory workers, summariser, graders) all use the configured model; auxiliary_model and model_fallbacks are empty.
notes.effort: Upstream hard-wires effort=max and max_tokens=128000 for Anthropic models. compat.patch makes the effort come from EVOSCIENTIST_REASONING_EFFORT (= conditions.effort); max_tokens stays 128000 (a cap, not a cost driver). Adaptive thinking (display=summarized) is upstream and not switchable.
notes.paper: The core writes a Markdown report (final_report.md); the EvoSkills paper-writing skill gives a generic LaTeX `article` skeleton with no ICML/ICLR/NeurIPS style and no compile step. The image has TeX Live (latexmk, fonts-extra) but no venue style files; the task asks for an official template, so a venue-formatted PDF depends on the agent obtaining the style through the shield. No extra pipeline stage was added; absent items are listed in result.missing.
notes.tools: skill_manager (git clone of any repository as a skill) is not registered (compat.patch); the Tavily key is not set so tavily_search does not exist; LANGGRAPH_CLI_NO_ANALYTICS=1; EvoSkills is baked in at its pinned commit. The execute shell and the EvoSkills paper-navigator scripts reach the world only through the shield; S2_DATE_CUTOFF is not set (the shield bounds dates).
notes.server_side_search: Not reachable: EvoScientist binds no provider-side search tool to any model (its only tools are think_tool, tavily_search when TAVILY_API_KEY is set, MCP tools from mcp.yaml, deepagents built-ins and skills; EvoScientist/EvoScientist.py:671-672 and 754-755 at the pin; the one bind_tools call is the tool selector's own output schema, middleware/tool_selector.py:166). TAVILY_API_KEY is not passed and the image has no mcp.yaml, so no search tool exists. Anthropic/OpenAI hosts are only tunnelled by the shield, so a provider-side search would be invisible to the audit.
notes.credentials: The provider key is in the process environment and EvoScientist's execute shell inherits the environment (upstream has no switch); the key is therefore visible to the agent's shell. It is a run-scoped copy and is not logged by this adapter.
notes.memory: A fresh data dir per run (baked skills, empty memory). Memory workers, skill synthesis and the scheduler stay at upstream defaults, so their LLM calls count in the usage log.
notes.limits: async sub-agents off (README advice for scripted runs); recursion_limit=1000000; model retry wait in auto-mode 21600 s (time without progress counts as wall time); execute timeout 300 s per command. No token or cost budget exists.

theses.title: 够好的 AI 科学家
theses.text: ResearchWorld 里只用普通的 coding agent（Claude Code + Sonnet）当 worker，就是一个够好的 AI 科学家。“够好”有两条标准：达到公开顶尖 agent 的水平（用同一审稿人给系统论文的分数除以给原论文的分数这个比值量，与解决线同一口径）；交付经过独立评审、可复现的结果。不以“赢过单 agent”为前提。
theses.text_en: With only an ordinary coding agent (Claude Code + Sonnet) as the worker, ResearchWorld is a good enough AI scientist. Good enough has two standards: reaching the level of the best public agents (measured by the ratio of the same reviewer's score of the system's paper to its score of the original paper, the same measure as the solve line), and delivering independently reviewed, reproducible results. Beating a single agent is not a premise.

theses.title: 检验 worker
theses.text: ResearchWorld 能检验 worker 的能力，方法是单岗位换 worker：只在 E2E 上，每题只换卡住它的那个岗位。
theses.text_en: ResearchWorld can check a worker's ability by swapping the worker of a single role, on E2E only and one role per task: the role that holds the task back.

theses.title: 改进 worker
theses.text: ResearchWorld 能作为改进 worker 的环境，改进器是一个简单的单 coding agent。有两条路：一是在便宜的 benchmark 上改进，改进能迁移到 world，使改进可控（阶段三，在 E2E 上测试）；二是在 ResearchWorld 自己的 E2E 运行轨迹上闭环改进，不引入外部知识（阶段四）。
theses.text_en: ResearchWorld can serve as the environment for improving a worker; the improver is a simple single coding agent. There are two routes: improving on cheap benchmarks, where the improvement transfers to the world, which makes improvement controllable (phase 3, tested on E2E); and a closed loop on ResearchWorld's own E2E trajectories with no outside knowledge (phase 4).

phases.title: 阶段一：够好的 AI 科学家
phases.title_en: Phase 1: a good enough AI scientist
phases.summary: 论点 1，只用 E2E：核心题集就是 e2e-formal 的 10 道 E2E。RW-sonnet 和 CC-sonnet 各跑 10 道，AS、EVO 的 sonnet 条件也各跑 10 道；GPT-6.1 Sol 列（维护者 2026-11-02 加，#185）是 RW-sol、CX-sol、AS-sol、EVO-sol 各跑 10 道；ARC（AutoResearchClaw）2026-11-11 由维护者移出基线（#303）：不补跑，阶段一已有的 ARC 运行和发布保留，系统仍可安装、`run --condition` 仍可用，原因见 ARC 条件的说明；前四个 Sol 条件都用 Codex 账号 codex-jack（维护者 2026-11-09 由 codex-2 改），已有的 Sonnet 结果保留、照常计入；t09、t10 的 CC-sonnet 结果用筛选时的那两次运行，其余 8 道新跑（单次运行上限 7 天，各系统相同）。E2E 与原论文的外部审稿分数相比；阶段一的 E2E 运行每 30 分钟打一个 checkpoint，供阶段二、三接续。RW-sonnet 的 10 道按 formal.toml 重跑（不设模型时间上限，#214；维护者 2026-11-04）：原来那批受 HuTian 默认 7200 s 模型时间上限、且多数停滞，已结束，不作阶段二起点。阶段一所有 RW 运行的 checkpoint 一律保留，只 archive，绝不 reclaim --apply。评测器检验（#356 第三步，维护者 2026-11-14）另加一个强弱已知的单 agent 阶梯：CC-haiku（Haiku high）、CC-sonnet-low（Sonnet low）在 ladder-e2e 的 6 道上各跑一次，第三档用 CC-sonnet 已有的正式运行（不重跑），Opus 暂不跑；预期评测手段把更弱的 worker 排在后面。
phases.summary_en: Thesis 1, E2E only: the core set is the 10 E2E tasks of e2e-formal. RW-sonnet and CC-sonnet run all 10, and so do the sonnet conditions of AS and EVO; the GPT-6.1 Sol column (added by the maintainer on 2026-11-02, #185) is RW-sol, CX-sol, AS-sol and EVO-sol running all 10; ARC (AutoResearchClaw) was dropped as a baseline by the maintainer on 2026-11-11 (#303): no reruns, the phase 1 ARC runs and releases stay, and the system stays installable and `run --condition` still works (reason: see the notes of the ARC conditions); the four Sol conditions use the Codex account codex-jack (changed by the maintainer on 2026-11-09 from codex-2), and the existing Sonnet results stay and count as before; the CC-sonnet results of t09 and t10 are the two screening runs, the other 8 tasks run anew (a 7-day cap per run, the same for every system). E2E is compared with the original papers' external review scores; the phase 1 E2E runs take a checkpoint every 30 minutes for phases 2 and 3 to continue from. The 10 RW-sonnet tasks rerun with formal.toml (no model-time cap, #214; maintainer, 2026-11-04): the earlier batch hit HuTian's default 7200 s model-time cap and mostly stalled, so it was ended and is not a phase 2 start. Every checkpoint of every phase 1 RW run is kept: archived at most, never reclaim --apply. The evaluator check (#356 step 3, maintainer 2026-11-14) adds a single-agent ladder of workers whose order is expected: CC-haiku (Haiku high) and CC-sonnet-low (Sonnet low) run the 6 tasks of ladder-e2e once each, the third rung is CC-sonnet's existing formal run (not rerun), and Opus is not run for now; the evaluators are expected to rank the weaker workers lower.

phases.title: 阶段二：换 worker
phases.summary: 论点 2，只用 E2E：ResearchWorld 里给岗位换 worker 很方便，换了之后产生可比较的差异（设计按维护者 2026-11-14 的结论，#357）。两种换法。一是只换一个岗位（接续），只换 experiment 和 paper：experiment 从早检查点接续，臂是对照（Sonnet，不换）、experiment 换 Codex + GPT-6.1-sol、experiment 换 Haiku，以及公开技能包臂（五个岗位同时带各自的包，等 ResearchWorld 优化后跑，开跑前先做一次触发试验，确认 worker 用上了 skill）；paper 从晚检查点接续，臂是对照、paper 换 Codex + GPT-6.1-sol。起点按每个 world 自己的记录选：被换岗位第一次交出实质产出（第一份对外交付、论文 PR）之前的最后一个 checkpoint，所以各题、各岗位的起点可以不同。每个起点一个从同一检查点重跑的对照，基线是它而不是父运行（接续会把后半段重做一遍）。不换 Opus，不用 Astra。二是全部岗位一起换（新条件，从头跑）：RW-haiku（Haiku high）、RW-sonnet-low（Sonnet low）各跑 e2e-formal 的 10 道，和单 agent 阶梯的 CC-haiku、CC-sonnet-low 逐档对应，回答 worker 由弱到强。选题（批次 phase2-e2e，只换一个岗位的接续用）：每个要报告的替换 6 道题；往上换（Codex + Sol、技能包）和往下换（Haiku）共用一组题和对照：在排名记录里 RW-sonnet 排在本题各条件前一半的题中，先取输给 CC-sonnet 的，按判官把握从高到低、同把握按题号，不足 6 道时依次用平局、把握为 unsure 的胜局补足（候选见看板阶段二的表，实际选题由维护者确认；ResearchWorld 优化后用新版本的运行重新算）。度量：统一评测器（#395）的同题比较，按论文、代码和结果、轨迹三部分给出相对原论文的强度；换成 Codex + Sol 的臂由 Claude 和 GPT 两个家族的判官各判一遍，两边方向一致才报告为有效应；效应看多道题上的方向是否一致（6 道题全同向时 p = 0.03），不重复运行。同一个父运行的接续共用屏蔽，可以同时跑（#273）。开跑要等评测器验收（#395）和选定的 ResearchWorld 版本。尽可能复用阶段一：单 agent 对照用阶段一的 CC-sonnet、CX-sol，阶段一的 RW-sol 是所有岗位都换成 sol 的参照。阶段一的 checkpoint 一律保留，不 reclaim --apply。
phases.summary_en: Thesis 2, E2E only: in ResearchWorld the worker of a role is easy to swap, and the swap produces differences that can be compared (design per the maintainer's conclusions of 2026-11-14, #357). Two kinds of swap. First, one role at a time (continuations), only experiment and paper: experiment continues from an early checkpoint with the arms control (Sonnet, unchanged), experiment on Codex + GPT-6.1-sol and experiment on Haiku, plus the public skill package arm (all five roles with their own packages at once, run after ResearchWorld is optimized, preceded by one trigger trial that checks the workers use the skills); paper continues from a late checkpoint with the arms control and paper on Codex + GPT-6.1-sol. The start is read from each world's own record: the last checkpoint before the swapped role first delivered substantive output (its first delivery to another role, its paper PR), so starts differ between tasks and roles. Every start has a control rerun from the same checkpoint, and that control is the baseline, not the parent run (a continuation redoes the second half). No Opus and no Astra. Second, every role at once (new conditions, from scratch): RW-haiku (Haiku high) and RW-sonnet-low (Sonnet low) each run the 10 tasks of e2e-formal, rung for rung with CC-haiku and CC-sonnet-low of the single-agent ladder, for workers from weak to strong. Selection (batch phase2-e2e, for the one-role continuations): 6 tasks per reported swap; swaps up (Codex + Sol, skill packages) and down (Haiku) share one set of tasks and controls: among the tasks where RW-sonnet is in the top half of the task's conditions in the ranking record, first those it lost to CC-sonnet, by the judge's confidence from the highest, then task id, topped up to 6 with ties and then wins the judge was unsure of (the candidates are in the dashboard's phase 2 table and the maintainer confirms the selection; after ResearchWorld is optimized they are computed again from the new version's runs). Measure: the unified evaluator's same-task comparison (#395), with a strength against the original paper for the paper, the code and results, and the trajectory; the arms on Codex + Sol are judged by a Claude and a GPT judge, and an effect is reported only when both agree in direction; an effect is the direction agreeing over tasks (all 6 in one direction: p = 0.03), with no repeated runs. Continuations of one parent share a shield and can run at once (#273). Runs start after the evaluator's acceptance (#395) and the choice of the ResearchWorld version. Phase 1 is reused wherever it can be: the single-agent controls are phase 1's CC-sonnet and CX-sol, and phase 1's RW-sol is the reference with every role on sol. Every phase 1 checkpoint is kept, never reclaim --apply.

runs.title: 只换一个岗位的接续：phase2-e2e 的选定题 × experiment（早检查点：对照、Codex + sol、Haiku）和 paper（晚检查点：对照、Codex + sol）
runs.title_en: One-role continuations: the selected tasks of phase2-e2e x experiment (early checkpoint: control, Codex + sol, Haiku) and paper (late checkpoint: control, Codex + sol)
runs.why: 接续是换 worker 的实验臂，不属于任何条件，列在运行页的接续里（起点、岗位、换了什么）；格子和平均分不计它们（#141、#142、#273）。开跑等评测器验收（#395）和选定的 ResearchWorld 版本。
runs.why_en: A continuation is an arm that swaps a worker and belongs to no condition; continuations are listed among the runs with their start, role and change, and count in no cell or mean (#141, #142, #273). Runs start after the evaluator's acceptance (#395) and the choice of the ResearchWorld version.

runs.title: 公开技能包臂：phase2-e2e 的选定题 × 五个岗位同时带各自的包（早检查点）
runs.title_en: Public skill package arm: the selected tasks of phase2-e2e x all five roles with their own packages (early checkpoint)
runs.why: 等 ResearchWorld 优化后跑（维护者 2026-11-14）。先做一次触发试验：一道题，带全部五个岗位的包起一次运行，每个岗位过了头两三个回合就停，看 worker 是否打开了 skill（#357 提案一）；接续不属于任何条件。
runs.why_en: Runs after ResearchWorld is optimized (maintainer, 2026-11-14). One trigger trial first: one task, one run with the packages of all five roles, stopped once every role has had two or three turns, to see whether the workers open the skills (#357 proposal 1); a continuation belongs to no condition.

runs.title: 全部岗位一起换：e2e-formal（10 道）× RW-haiku、RW-sonnet-low（从头跑）
runs.title_en: Every role at once: e2e-formal (10 tasks) x RW-haiku, RW-sonnet-low (from scratch)
runs.why: worker 由弱到强：和 RW-sonnet 只差模型或 thinking level，和单 agent 阶梯逐档对应（#357）。开跑等评测器验收（#395）和选定的 ResearchWorld 版本。
runs.why_en: Workers from weak to strong: they differ from RW-sonnet only in the model or the thinking level and match the single-agent ladder rung for rung (#357). Runs start after the evaluator's acceptance (#395) and the choice of the ResearchWorld version.

phases.title: 阶段三：在 benchmark 上改进，在 E2E 上测试
phases.title_en: Phase 3: improve on benchmarks, test on E2E
phases.summary: 论点 3。benchmark 只作训练环境，按岗位和语境选 8 个：2 个写作（PaperWrite-Bench、PaperWritingBench）、2 个审稿（FLAWS、PaperAudit-Bench）、4 个做实验（CausalDS、MLS-Bench、EXP-Bench、ASI-Bench 的 ML/统计子集），每个 2 道训练题、1 道留出题，共 16 道训练题（phase3-train）、8 道留出题（phase3-heldout）；选题规则事先写在 #141，由 #157 按 sha256 确定性算出；题的领域要和 E2E 的方向对口（机器学习评测、统计方法、因果推断、不确定性量化），不对口的按同一顺序换成下一道对口的题（规则第 6 条，标注在 src/tasks/phase3-domain.yaml，#259）。改进器（Claude Code + Opus）读 RW-sonnet 在训练题上的运行记录，改出按岗位的技能包；第 0 轮是 RW-sonnet 不带包。最终测试：benchmark 留出题，以及 E2E 的技能包臂、RW-sonnet 带包、CC-sonnet 带包三项。对照改进器只用单 agent 环境，它的第 0 轮是 CC-sonnet 不带包。
phases.summary_en: Thesis 3. Benchmarks are only a training environment, 8 chosen by role and context: 2 writing (PaperWrite-Bench, PaperWritingBench), 2 review (FLAWS, PaperAudit-Bench) and 4 experiment (CausalDS, MLS-Bench, EXP-Bench and the ASI-Bench ML/statistics subset), each with 2 training items and 1 held out: 16 training items (phase3-train) and 8 held-out items (phase3-heldout). The selection rule was written in #141 beforehand and #157 computes it deterministically from sha256; an item must also fit the E2E direction (ML evaluation, statistical methods, causal inference, uncertainty quantification), and one that does not is replaced by the next fitting item in the same order (rule 6, labels in src/tasks/phase3-domain.yaml, #259). The improver (Claude Code + Opus) reads RW-sonnet's runs on the training items and writes per-role skill packages; round 0 is RW-sonnet without a package. Final tests: the held-out benchmark items, and on E2E the skill-package arm, RW-sonnet with the package and CC-sonnet with the package. A control improver works in a single-agent environment only; its round 0 is CC-sonnet without a package.

phases.title: 阶段四：用 E2E 上自己的轨迹改进 worker（闭环）
phases.title_en: Phase 4: improving the worker from its own E2E trajectories (closed loop)
phases.summary: 论点 3 的第二条路。和阶段三的技能包一样，但技能包来自 worker 自己的轨迹，不来自外部。改进器（Claude Code + Opus）只读 ResearchWorld 自己记下的 E2E 运行记录：Forgejo 历史、内部评审、receipt 和交付，绝不读评测侧的材料（原论文、rubric 等）。一道题自己的轨迹，绝不用来改进之后在这道题上测试的 worker。训练和测试分开：e2e-formal 的 10 道按方向分成两折（e2e-fold-a：t06、t07、a01、t09、t02；e2e-fold-b：r03、a06、t03、r02、t10，规则写在批次文件和 #141），用一折的轨迹改进、在另一折上测，再对调；复用阶段一的运行（维护者定，#141）。最终测试和阶段三相同：阶段二 checkpoint 上的技能包臂、RW-sonnet 带包、CC-sonnet 带包。这样可以直接比较 benchmark 上训练出的包（阶段三）和自己轨迹训练出的包（阶段四）。
phases.summary_en: The second route of thesis 3. Like the packages of phase 3, but the skill packages come from the worker's own trajectories, not from outside. The improver (Claude Code + Opus) reads only ResearchWorld's own records of E2E runs: Forgejo history, internal reviews, receipts and deliverables; it never reads evaluator-side material such as the original paper or the rubric. A task's own trajectories are never used to improve the worker that is then tested on that task. Training and testing are kept apart: the 10 e2e-formal tasks are split by direction into two folds (e2e-fold-a: t06, t07, a01, t09, t02; e2e-fold-b: r03, a06, t03, r02, t10; the rule is in the batch files and #141); the trajectories of one fold improve the worker and the other fold tests it, then the roles swap, reusing the phase 1 runs (maintainer, #141). The final tests are as in phase 3: a package arm on the phase 2 checkpoints, RW-sonnet with the package and CC-sonnet with the package. This allows a direct comparison of benchmark-trained packages (phase 3) and self-trained packages (phase 4).

runs.title: 改进回路：E2E 训练题 × RW-sonnet 带候选技能包
runs.title_en: Improvement loop: E2E training tasks x RW-sonnet with a candidate skill package

runs.why_en: The trajectories of one fold improve the worker and the other fold tests it; the skill packages are the improver's output and do not exist yet, so the conditions are not defined (#141).

runs.title: 最终测试：E2E 技能包臂、RW-sonnet 带包、CC-sonnet 带包

runs.why_en: The test fold is the other one; the conditions are defined only once the skill packages are produced (#141).

unranked.reason: 世界 2026-11-06 以 terminal（stalled）结束：论文已写完并通过科学评审，但岗位把协作过程中各自的克隆、worktree 和缓存计入题目的“存储 < 5 GB”，重建出 5,144,802,716 字节；internal-review-repo 认定这是无法补救的历史违规，拒绝发布，paper-repo 关闭了发布 PR，世界再无进展。维护者同意从 23:31 的 checkpoint 接续一次（researchworld-r03-20261107T074135Z，对照，不换 worker），13 个回合后以同样原因结束。成因在 ResearchWorld 自身的协作和评审，不是环境（维护者 2026-11-07 同意计为系统失败）。
unranked.reason_en: The world ended terminal (stalled) on 2026-11-06: the paper was written and passed scientific review, but the roles counted their own clones, worktrees and caches from the collaboration against the task's "storage < 5 GB", reconstructing 5,144,802,716 bytes; internal-review-repo judged it an unrepairable past violation and refused release, paper-repo closed the release PR, and the world made no further progress. With the maintainer's agreement one continuation ran from the 23:31 checkpoint (researchworld-r03-20261107T074135Z, control, same workers) and ended the same way after 13 turns. The cause is ResearchWorld's own collaboration and review, not the environment (maintainer agreed to count it as a system failure, 2026-11-07).

extra_resources.reason: AS-sol 在 t07 上此前的运行都没有论文，都败在它自己的任务起草阶段：AS-sol 把同一基准的题分成搜索和最终两半，它自己的对齐评审要求核实两半的原题不重复、模型身份和家族不交叉；上游矩阵只有 0/1 分数，没有每一列对应的原题，原题只在 HuggingFace 上要登录并同意条款的逐题明细里，系统拿不到（匿名访问 401）。维护者决定只为这一格提前准备这份数据再跑：得分矩阵每一列对应的原题（Open LLM Leaderboard 七个矩阵取自 3 个模型的 gated 明细，HELM 六个矩阵取自公开桶）、每一行对应的模型名，和 leaderboard 公开的模型元数据。不含分数、模型输出、划分或任何解法提示；13 个矩阵都与上游逐格核对过。其他条件和其他题都不给，所以这一格的结果和其他格子不是在同样的条件下得到的。
extra_resources.reason_en: The earlier runs of AS-sol on t07 all ended without a paper, in AS's own task-drafting phase: AS-sol splits the items of one benchmark into a search half and a final half, and its own alignment review requires verifying that the two halves share no original question and that model identities and families do not cross; the upstream matrices hold only 0/1 scores and not the question behind each column, and the questions are only in per-item details on HuggingFace that need a login and accepted terms, which the system cannot get (401 for anonymous requests). The maintainer decided to prepare this data for this one cell and run it again: the original question of each column of the score matrices (the seven Open LLM Leaderboard matrices from the gated details of 3 models, the six HELM matrices from the public bucket), the model name of each row, and the leaderboard's public model metadata. No scores, model outputs, splits or solution hints; all 13 matrices were checked cell by cell against upstream. No other condition and no other task gets it, so the result of this cell was not obtained under the same conditions as the other cells.

verdicts.reason: 世界 2026-11-06 以 terminal（stalled）结束：论文已写完并通过科学评审，但岗位把协作过程中各自的克隆、worktree 和缓存计入题目的“存储 < 5 GB”，重建出 5,144,802,716 字节；internal-review-repo 认定这是无法补救的历史违规，拒绝发布，paper-repo 关闭了发布 PR，世界再无进展。维护者同意从 23:31 的 checkpoint 接续一次（researchworld-r03-20261107T074135Z，对照，不换 worker），13 个回合后以同样原因结束。成因在 ResearchWorld 自身的协作和评审，不是环境（维护者 2026-11-07 同意计为系统失败）。
verdicts.reason_en: The world ended terminal (stalled) on 2026-11-06: the paper was written and passed scientific review, but the roles counted their own clones, worktrees and caches from the collaboration against the task's "storage < 5 GB", reconstructing 5,144,802,716 bytes; internal-review-repo judged it an unrepairable past violation and refused release, paper-repo closed the release PR, and the world made no further progress. With the maintainer's agreement one continuation ran from the 23:31 checkpoint (researchworld-r03-20261107T074135Z, control, same workers) and ended the same way after 13 turns. The cause is ResearchWorld's own collaboration and review, not the environment (maintainer agreed to count it as a system failure, 2026-11-07).

means.zh: 在 2025 年 ICLR/ICML/NeurIPS 的 oral 论文里找出被注入的错误（220 篇，每篇约 10 处、8 类），按错误覆盖率、发现精确率和 F1 评分。
means.en: Finding the errors injected into 2025 ICLR/ICML/NeurIPS oral papers (220 papers, about 10 errors in 8 categories each), scored by error coverage, finding precision and F1.

means.zh: 在 ICML 2025 论文里找出被插入的致命错误（713 对）：给改过的论文，交至多 10 段按可能性排序的原文摘录，词级 Levenshtein 或 LLM 判官认可即命中。
means.en: Finding the fatal error inserted into an ICML 2025 paper (713 pairs): the altered paper is given and at most 10 verbatim excerpts ranked by likelihood are returned; a hit by word-level Levenshtein or the LLM judge.

means.zh: 合成场景上的因果推断：用代码回答效应、置信区间、可识别性（不可识别时拒答）和反事实问题，按生成数据的结构因果模型确定性判分（发布的 100 题 realistic 考卷）。
means.en: Causal inference on synthetic scenes: answer effect, confidence-interval, identifiability (abstain when a target is not identifiable) and counterfactual questions with code, graded deterministically against the generating structural causal model (the released 100-task realistic exam).

means.zh: 完整的研究实验：给问题、方法和遮住部分文件的论文仓库，设计、实现、运行并给出结论（本项目用不需要 GPU 的 13 题）。
means.en: A complete research experiment from a question, a method and a paper repository with some files masked: design, implement, run and conclude (this project uses the 13 tasks that need no GPU).

means.zh: 机器学习科学：在真实库的 scaffold 里做一处受限的算法改动，跨设置和种子评测，对基线归一化（本项目只用 22 个 CPU 题）。
means.en: Machine learning science: one constrained algorithmic change inside the scaffold of a real library, judged over settings and seeds and normalised against baselines (this project uses the 22 CPU tasks).

means.en: An LLM judge that scores an E2E task's rubric item by item (0-100), with several samples. An auxiliary score since 2026-11-01; an E2E run's main score is the external reviewers'.

means.en: MLR-Bench's paper reviewer (1-10), reading the paper's text and the images of its figure pages; an add-on score (#275).

means.zh: 数论文主结果背后独立重复的次数（种子数）和带数字报告的消融、敏感性、稳健性分析的个数；是计数，不是分数，只在同一道题的论文之间比较（#356）。
means.en: Counts the independent repetitions behind a paper's main result (seeds) and the ablation, sensitivity and robustness analyses it reports with numbers; counts, not a score, compared only between papers of the same task (#356).

means.zh: 论文里报告本研究结果的每一句话和每张表，分别和交付的结果文件、论文别处的同一个量比，数出值对不上的条数；一篇一次模型调用，不起容器、不重跑；是计数，不是分数（#367）。
means.en: Compares every sentence and table that reports a result of the study with the same quantity in the delivered result files and elsewhere in the paper, and counts the entries whose values disagree; one model call per paper, no container and no rerun; a count, not a score (#367).

means.zh: 与数字核实相同的提示和输入，换成 Claude 判官；和 GPT 判官的结果对照，看跨模型家族的比较是否一致（#367）。
means.en: The number check with the same prompt and inputs and a Claude judge; set against the GPT judge's result to see whether comparisons across model families agree (#367).

means.zh: Claude Code 或 Codex 在审稿沙箱里读一个运行的论文（PDF 和 LaTeX）、代码、结果和统一轨迹，写出一份带位置的发现清单；代码复核原句、位置和抽数命令，再数出论文、代码和结果、轨迹各部分的量和及格线；是计数，不是分数（#378）。
means.en: Claude Code or Codex reads a run's paper (PDF and LaTeX), code, results and unified trajectory in the review sandbox and writes a list of findings with locations; code checks the quotes, locations and extraction commands, then counts measures for the paper, the code and results, the trajectory and the pass conditions; counts, not a score (#378).

means.zh: 把论文的数字结论逐条对照交付的代码、数据和结果，报告已核实的比例（0–1）和各类编造；在容器和联网屏蔽里运行；附加分数（#275）。
means.en: Checks each numerical claim of the paper against the delivered code, data and results and reports the verified share (0-1) and each kind of fabrication; runs in the container and network shield; an add-on score (#275).

means.zh: 同一道题的一批论文加原论文，每对两种顺序各比一次，Bradley–Terry 汇总成批内排序；附加分数（#275）。
means.en: Ranks one task's papers with the original among them, each pair compared in both orders and aggregated by Bradley-Terry; an add-on score (#275).

means.zh: paperreview.ai 的审稿（手工提交，看板解析保存的审稿页）。
means.en: paperreview.ai's review (submitted by hand; the saved review page is parsed).

means.zh: PaperWritingBench 的官方指标（引用 F1 等）。
means.en: PaperWritingBench's official metrics (citation F1 and more).

means.zh: ScienceAgentBench 的官方评测程序（SR、VER、CBS）。
means.en: ScienceAgentBench's official evaluation (SR, VER, CBS).

means.zh: 每个任务的官方验证程序，reward 为 0 或 1。
means.en: Each task's official verifier; the reward is 0 or 1.

means.zh: 经 Harbor 运行的题目，取该任务自己的验证程序在 trial 里给出的 reward，不重放、不用 LLM。
means.en: For an item run through Harbor: the reward the task's own verifier gave in the trial; no replay, no LLM.

means.zh: ASI-Bench 的官方公开评分程序，按每题的门槛和 scorer 打 0–100 分；用公开的 seed31415 参考答案，是本地非官方分数。
means.en: ASI-Bench's official public scorer: 0-100 by each task's gates and scorers, against the public seed31415 references; a local, non-official score.

means.zh: 按目标论文检查清单加权打分（0–100）的官方 LLM 判官。
means.en: The official LLM judge, a weighted score against the target study's checklist (0-100).

means.zh: TruthInsightBench 的官方评分（0–100）：LLM 判官逐项给每条发现打分，对照隐藏的参考发现，再用文献检索和固定运算复核。
means.en: TruthInsightBench's official scoring (0-100): an LLM judge scores each finding item by item, matches the hidden reference findings, then a closure stage checks prior art and recomputes numbers.

means.zh: PaperWrite-Bench 的官方 rubric 评分（1–5）和引用、幻觉指标。
means.en: PaperWrite-Bench's official rubric score (1-5) with citation and hallucination metrics.

means.zh: 论文附录 H 的三阶段评分（初评、复核、裁决）：Atomic Score（0–10）和研究闭环等级 RC0–RC4。
means.en: The paper's Appendix H three-stage grading (first pass, review, adjudication): an Atomic Score (0-10) and a Research Closure level RC0-RC4.

means.zh: PaperAudit-Bench 的官方匹配：LLM 判官判断每个注入的错误有没有被某条发现抓到，算每篇的错误覆盖率、发现精确率和 F1。
means.en: PaperAudit-Bench's official matching: an LLM judge decides which injected errors are captured by a finding; per paper error coverage, finding precision and F1.

means.zh: FLAWS 的官方匹配：前 10 段摘录里有一段与插入的错误处词级 Levenshtein 相似度 ≥ 0.5，或 LLM 判官认可，则命中（0/1）。
means.en: FLAWS's official matching: a hit (0/1) when one of the first 10 excerpts has word-level Levenshtein similarity >= 0.5 to the inserted error place, or the LLM judge agrees.

means.zh: CausalDS 自带的确定性评分（固定 commit 的 grade_exam）：离散题精确匹配，数值题归一化误差，图和集合题 F1，预测题用留出标签；没有 LLM。
means.en: CausalDS's own deterministic grading (grade_exam of the pinned commit): exact match for discrete answers, normalised error for numbers, F1 for graphs and sets, held-out labels for predictions; no LLM.

means.zh: EXP-Bench 的官方评判：监控判官查违规，设计、结论、实现判官打分，再在新容器里运行交付的脚本做执行检查。
means.en: EXP-Bench's official judging: a monitor judge looks for violations, design, conclusion and setup judges score, then the delivered script is run in a fresh container as an execution check.

means.zh: MLS-Bench 自带的验证器：编辑范围守卫、运行任务的全部评测脚本、对基线归一化成 0–1 的 reward，没有 LLM。
means.en: MLS-Bench's own verifier: an edit-range guard, all eval scripts of the task, a baseline-normalised reward in 0-1; no LLM.

means.zh: 检查论文里的实证陈述有没有问题的附加 LLM 判官（越低越好）。
means.en: An additional LLM judge that checks the paper's empirical claims (lower is better).

means.zh: PhysClosureBench：20 条半分准则里通过或不适用的各得 0.5 分，满分 10。
means.en: PhysClosureBench: 0.5 for each of the 20 half-point criteria that passes or is not applicable; the maximum is 10.

means.zh: PhysClosureBench：判官按 rubric 判断研究是否闭合，RC4 最完整；独立于 Atomic Score，不设分数上下限。
means.en: PhysClosureBench: the judge's decision on how completely the research closes against the rubric, RC4 being complete; independent of the Atomic Score, with no score ceiling or floor.

means.zh: E2E：同一个外部审稿人给这个任务原论文的分数（release reviews-originals-20261027），是系统所写论文分数的锚点。
means.en: E2E: the score the same external reviewer gave the task's original paper (release reviews-originals-20261027), the anchor of the score of the paper a system wrote.

means.zh: E2E：系统论文的审稿分数除以同一个审稿人给原论文的分数。两个审稿人各自一个比值，不相加。
means.en: E2E: the review score of the system's paper divided by the same reviewer's score of the original paper. Each reviewer has its own ratio; they are not added.

means.zh: 算作“解决”的分数。E2E：Stanford Estimated Score 达到原论文的 80%，逐题计算；ASI-Bench：硬门槛通过且不少于 80/100（维护者 2026-11-01 定）。
means.en: The score at which a task counts as solved. E2E: a Stanford Estimated Score of 80% of the original paper's, task by task; ASI-Bench: the hard gates pass and the score is at least 80/100 (maintainer, 2026-11-01).

means.zh: 分数是否达到该任务的解决线（yes 或 no）。
means.en: Whether the score reaches the task's solve line (yes or no).

means.zh: ScienceAgentBench：程序输出达到任务成功标准的比例。
means.en: ScienceAgentBench: the share of programs whose output meets the task's success criterion.

means.zh: ScienceAgentBench：程序能无错运行并产生输出的比例。
means.en: ScienceAgentBench: the share of programs that run without error and produce output.

means.zh: ScienceAgentBench：生成程序与参考程序的 CodeBERT 相似度。
means.en: ScienceAgentBench: CodeBERT similarity between the generated and the reference program.

name.zh: 隐藏参考发现的恢复分

means.zh: TruthInsightBench：运行的发现恢复了任务两条隐藏参考发现的程度（0–10，每条最多 5 分）。
means.en: TruthInsightBench: how far the run's findings recover the task's two hidden reference findings (0-10, up to 5 each).

means.zh: 把两篇论文放在一起由判官比较优劣的评测方式。
means.en: A judge compares two papers placed side by side.

means.zh: PaperAudit-Bench：被发现抓到的注入错误占全部注入错误的比例（EC）。
means.en: PaperAudit-Bench: the share of injected errors captured by some finding (EC).

means.zh: PaperAudit-Bench：对上了注入错误的发现占全部发现的比例（FP）。
means.en: PaperAudit-Bench: the share of findings that match an injected error (FP).

means.zh: FLAWS：前 3 段摘录里就找到了插入的错误（0/1）；主分数看前 10 段。
means.en: FLAWS: the inserted error is found within the first 3 excerpts (0/1); the main score looks at the first 10.

means.zh: FLAWS：有一段摘录与插入的错误处词级 Levenshtein 相似度 ≥ 0.5（0/1）。
means.en: FLAWS: an excerpt has word-level Levenshtein similarity >= 0.5 to the inserted error place (0/1).

means.zh: FLAWS：LLM 判官认定有一段摘录对上了插入的错误处（0/1）。
means.en: FLAWS: the LLM judge says an excerpt matches the inserted error place (0/1).

means.zh: CausalDS 的损失：离散题 1−通过，数值题归一化误差，图和集合题 1−F1（论文按题数加权汇总；这里是单题值，越低越好）。
means.en: CausalDS's loss: 1 minus pass for a discrete task, the normalised error for a numeric one, 1 minus F1 for a graph or set (the paper aggregates them weighted by task count; this is the single task's value, lower is better).

means.zh: CausalDS 的离散题是否通过（精确匹配，含对不可识别目标的拒答决定，0/1）；数值题和集合题没有这一项。
means.en: Whether a CausalDS discrete task is passed (exact match, including the decision to abstain on a non-identifiable target; 0/1); numeric and set tasks have none.

means.zh: EXP-Bench：实验设计里与标准变量对上的比例（0–1）。
means.en: EXP-Bench: the share of the ground-truth variables the experiment design matches (0-1).

means.zh: EXP-Bench：补丁满足的实现要求的比例（0–1）。
means.en: EXP-Bench: the share of the implementation requirements the patch meets (0-1).

means.zh: EXP-Bench：结论与标准结论语义一致（0/1）。
means.en: EXP-Bench: the conclusion matches the ground-truth conclusion semantically (0/1).

means.zh: EXP-Bench：交付的复现脚本在新容器里退出码为 0（0/1）。
means.en: EXP-Bench: the delivered reproduction script exits with code 0 in a fresh container (0/1).

means.zh: MLS-Bench：任务的各项指标对基线归一化后的聚合得分（未限制范围；reward 是把它限制到 0–1）。
means.en: MLS-Bench: the aggregate of the task's metrics normalised against the baselines (unclipped; the reward clips it to 0-1).

means.zh: 论文引用与参考引用匹配的 F1。
means.en: F1 of the paper's citations against the reference citations.

means.zh: PaperWrite-Bench：判官找到的严重事实错误条数。
means.en: PaperWrite-Bench: the number of major factual errors the judge found.

means.zh: PaperWritingBench：判官对相关工作部分的总评。
means.en: PaperWritingBench: the judge's overall rating of the related-work section.

means.zh: PaperWritingBench：AgentReview 审稿器对整篇论文的总评。
means.en: PaperWritingBench: the AgentReview reviewer's overall rating of the whole paper.

name.zh: SxS 论文质量（对原论文）

means.zh: PaperWritingBench：判官把系统的论文与原论文并排比较论文质量，结果是 win、tie 或 loss（系统一方）。
means.en: PaperWritingBench: the judge compares the system's paper with the original side by side on paper quality; win, tie or loss for the system.

name.zh: SxS 文献综述（对原论文）

means.zh: PaperWritingBench：判官把系统与原论文的相关工作部分并排比较，结果是 win、tie 或 loss（系统一方）。
means.en: PaperWritingBench: the judge compares the related-work sections of the system's paper and the original side by side; win, tie or loss for the system.

name.zh: 有问题陈述比例（Gemini 判官）

means.zh: 忠实度判官用 Gemini 时，有问题的实证陈述占比。
means.en: With the Gemini judge, the share of empirical claims with a problem.

means.zh: Terminal-Bench-Science 验证程序给出的 0 或 1。
means.en: 0 or 1 from the Terminal-Bench-Science verifier.

means.zh: ASI-Bench 软门槛（如代码里是否出现要求的做法）没通过的个数；不影响得分，只作记录。
means.en: The number of ASI-Bench soft gates (for example, whether the code shows a required approach) that did not pass; it does not change the score and is only recorded.

means.zh: 评测侧按原论文写的逐项评分标准。
means.en: The item-by-item scoring standard written from the original paper on the evaluator side.

means.zh: 运行记录在跑，进程（或系统自己的驱动）还活着。
means.en: The run is recorded as running and its process (or the system's own driver) is alive.

means.zh: 命令已返回，系统自己的驱动（例如 HuTian 的服务）还在跑。
means.en: The command has returned; the system's own driver (for example HuTian's service) still runs.

name.zh: 记录在跑但进程已不在

means.zh: 记录还是 running，但记录的进程已经不在；需要用 runs 命令收尾。
means.en: The record still says running but its process is gone; the runs command closes it.

means.zh: 系统正常结束并交付。
means.en: The system ended normally and delivered.

means.zh: 系统出错结束。
means.en: The system ended with an error.

means.zh: 用完了时间、预算或回合上限。
means.en: It used up its time, budget or turn limit.

means.zh: 被 stop 命令停止。
means.en: Stopped by the stop command.

means.zh: 运行没能开始（例如预检失败）。
means.en: The run could not start (for example a failed preflight).

means.zh: 进程消失且没有结果，记录被收尾为 lost。
means.en: The process disappeared without a result; the record was closed as lost.

means.zh: world 的研究预算用完了：计费回合的模型时间（max_model_seconds）或回合数上限（max_executions）；不是墙钟时间上限（HuTian DEV.md 11.12）。
means.en: The world used up its research budget: the model time of billed turns (max_model_seconds) or the turn cap (max_executions); not the wall-clock limit (HuTian DEV.md 11.12).

means.zh: 到了这次驱动的墙钟截止时间（--deadline-sec 与 world 的 total_seconds 取早者）。
means.en: The drive reached its wall-clock deadline (the earlier of --deadline-sec and the world's total_seconds).

means.zh: 剩下的墙钟少于开一个回合需要的秒数（start_seconds），驱动停下（HuTian DEV.md 11.12）。
means.en: The wall clock left was below what a new turn needs (start_seconds), so the driver stopped (HuTian DEV.md 11.12).

means.zh: 这次驱动用完了 --max-executions 给的执行次数。
means.en: The drive used up the executions --max-executions allowed.

means.zh: 驱动看到 world 一直空闲而停下。
means.en: The driver stopped because the world stayed idle.

means.zh: 这一格还没有运行。
means.en: This cell has no run yet.

means.zh: 维护者定为不跑的系统 × benchmark 组合（conditions.yaml 的 plan.unsupported），原因写在格子里。
means.en: A system × benchmark combination the maintainer decided not to run (plan.unsupported in conditions.yaml); the cell gives the reason.

means.zh: 这一格最近一次运行完成。
means.en: The latest run of this cell completed.

means.zh: 有完成或失败的格子，但没有全部完成。
means.en: Some cells are done or failed, not all are done.

means.zh: 维护者还没有决定（条件的设置，或哪些格子要跑）。
means.en: Not decided by the maintainer yet (a condition's setting, or which cells run).

means.zh: 计入的那次运行有 Stanford 分数（给出分数、相对原论文的比值和是否过解出线）。
means.en: The run that counts has a Stanford score (shown with its ratio to the original paper and whether it passes the solve line).

means.zh: 计入的运行已完成、有论文，还没有 Stanford 分数（等维护者送审，或审稿页已有、分数待解析）。
means.en: The run that counts completed with a paper and has no Stanford score yet (waiting for the maintainer's review, or the review page is on file and its score is to be parsed).

means.zh: 维护者定为这篇论文不送审（plan.verdicts 的 not-reviewed），这一格不会有 Stanford 分数。
means.en: The maintainer decided this paper is not sent for review (a not-reviewed verdict in plan.verdicts), so the cell will not get a Stanford score.

means.zh: 运行正常结束，但没有交付论文 PDF，无从送审。
means.en: The run ended normally but delivered no paper PDF, so there is nothing to review.

means.zh: 最近的运行被停止（stop）且没有判定；停止原因写在格子里，原因消除后可恢复或重跑。
means.en: The latest run was stopped and has no verdict; the stop reason is in the cell, and the run can be resumed or rerun once the reason is gone.

means.zh: 判定为被测系统自身的失败（plan.verdicts 的 system-failure）：计入结果，不重跑。
means.en: Judged to be the system under test's own failure (a system-failure verdict in plan.verdicts): it counts in the result and is not rerun.

means.zh: 判定为环境造成的失败（plan.verdicts 的 environment-failure，例如代理没有可用账号、Docker 太慢）：不计入结果，要重跑。
means.en: Judged to be caused by the environment (an environment-failure verdict in plan.verdicts, for example a proxy with no available account or a slow Docker): it does not count and is to be rerun.

means.zh: 维护者定为不派出这一格的运行（plan.verdicts 的 not-dispatched）；已有的环境失败运行仍在历史里。
means.en: The maintainer decided no run is dispatched for this cell (a not-dispatched verdict in plan.verdicts); any environment-failure run stays in the history.

means.zh: 运行失败，还没有判定是系统自身失败还是环境失败。
means.en: The run failed and has not been judged a system failure or an environment failure yet.

means.zh: 判定为被后来的运行取代（plan.verdicts 的 superseded）：不计入，分数只留在历史里。
means.en: Judged to be replaced by a later run (a superseded verdict in plan.verdicts): it does not count and its score stays in the history only.

means.zh: 正式的评测运行；只有它进入矩阵和评测汇总。
means.en: A formal evaluation run; only these count in the matrix and the evaluation summaries.

means.zh: 检查系统、评测或设置是否可用的运行，不算评测结果。
means.en: A run that checks a system, an evaluator or a setting; not an evaluation result.

means.zh: 在冒烟任务 s00 上用最小设置证明流程走通，不代表质量。
means.en: Proves the path works on the smoke task s00 with the smallest settings; says nothing about quality.

means.zh: 评测系统自己的运行。
means.en: An evaluator's own run.

means.zh: 审稿人对论文的运行。
means.en: A reviewer's run on a paper.

means.zh: 运行只能经代理上网：屏蔽表里的地址（原论文、看板等）被拦截，文献检索按时间截止过滤。
means.en: A run reaches the network only through a proxy: addresses on the blocklist (the original paper, the dashboard and more) are blocked, and literature search is cut off at the time cutoff.

means.zh: 联网屏蔽的正式模式：拦截屏蔽表，按时间截止过滤检索。
means.en: The formal shield mode: the blocklist is enforced and search is date-bounded.

name.zh: 全部经屏蔽代理（HuTian 的强制上游代理）
name.en: Everything through the shield proxy (HuTian's mandatory upstream proxy)

means.zh: ResearchWorld 的屏蔽模式（HuTian v4.2.0 起）：每个岗位的每个请求都经本次运行的屏蔽代理，规则与其他系统相同（URL、关键词、id、日期），代理记下每个完整 URL；没有直连出口，服务商端检索和远端工具关闭。E2E 和 benchmark 题相同。
means.en: ResearchWorld's shield mode (from HuTian v4.2.0): every request of every role goes through the run's shield proxy, with the same rules as the other systems (URL, keyword, id, date), and the proxy logs each full URL; there is no direct way out, and server-side search and remote tools are off. The same for E2E tasks and benchmark items.

name.zh: 名单主机经代理（早期屏蔽模式）
name.en: Listed hosts through the proxy (earlier shield mode)

means.zh: ResearchWorld 在 HuTian v4.1.0 下的屏蔽模式（#73 之前的运行）：屏蔽表涉及的主机经同一个代理、按同样规则拦截和过滤；其余主机走 HuTian 的开放网络，屏蔽表的关键词和 id 在那里只做事后审计。
means.en: ResearchWorld's shield mode under HuTian v4.1.0 (runs before #73): the hosts the blocklist touches go through the same proxy with the same rules; other hosts go over HuTian's open network, where the blocklist's keywords and ids are only audited afterwards.

means.zh: 这一题的官方 agent 没有网页访问：屏蔽只放行模型供应商和 Python 包索引（pip、uv 装包，运行记录的 package_index 为 allowed），其余请求一律拒绝（规则 offline），受控检索也拒绝；ResearchWorld 的 world 同样经屏蔽代理（#105 之前的离线运行不设网络资源）。
means.en: The item's official agents have no web access: the shield lets only the model provider and the Python package index through (pip and uv installs; the run record says package_index: allowed) and refuses every other request (rule offline), search included; a ResearchWorld world goes through the shield proxy too (offline runs before #105 got no network resource).

name.zh: 按主机拒绝（ResearchWorld 早期的 benchmark 题）
name.en: Hosts denied (ResearchWorld on a benchmark item

means.zh: 在 HuTian v4.1.0 下（#73 之前的运行），ResearchWorld 跑 benchmark 题时走 HuTian 的开放网络，题目屏蔽表里能整站拒绝的主机写进网络资源的 deny 列表；HuTian 的网关只看主机，共享站点上的 URL、关键词和 id 只做事后审计。
means.en: Under HuTian v4.1.0 (runs before #73), ResearchWorld on a benchmark item used HuTian's open network, with the hosts of the item's blocklist that can be refused whole on the network resource's deny list; HuTian's gateway sees hosts only, so URLs on shared hosts, keywords and ids were only audited afterwards.

name.zh: 在官方任务镜像里工作
name.en: Works in the official task image

means.zh: 基准有自己的 agent 环境镜像（Terminal-Bench-Science）时，系统在以它为底构建的镜像里工作，文件就在任务给的位置。
means.en: When a benchmark has its own agent environment image (Terminal-Bench-Science), the system works in an image built on it, with the files where the task put them.

means.zh: 系统不能在官方任务镜像里工作：任务镜像里的文件复制到它的工作目录。
means.en: The system cannot work inside the official task image: the image's files are copied into its working directory.

name.zh: 系统自己的镜像加装任务软件
name.en: The system's own image with the task's software

means.zh: 系统不能在官方任务镜像里工作：在它自己的镜像上装任务的系统软件包和独立的 /opt/task-env Python（task_software.yaml），文件复制到工作目录。
means.en: The system cannot work inside the official task image: the task's system packages and a separate /opt/task-env Python (task_software.yaml) are installed on its own image, and the files are copied into its working directory.

name.en: researchworld run (the entry for E2E tasks)

means.zh: E2E 任务用 HuTian 的 run 建 world、由 HuTian 自己的服务驱动，用全部 9 个岗位，可以断点续跑。
means.en: An E2E task: HuTian's run makes the world and HuTian's own service drives it, with all 9 roles; it can resume after a restart.

name.en: researchworld agent (the entry for benchmark items)

means.zh: benchmark 题用 HuTian 给外部评测的入口 agent：固定提示和输入，交付文件齐全才结束；岗位按 HuTian 对该 benchmark 的官方设置。
means.en: A benchmark item: HuTian's entry for external harnesses, agent; it fixes the prompt and inputs and ends only with the required files; the roles follow HuTian's official setting for that benchmark.

means.zh: 交付由检查程序运行或读取的文件。
means.en: Files that a checker runs or reads.

means.zh: 交付一份分析报告及其代码和产出。
means.en: An analysis delivered with its code, outputs and report.

means.zh: 由给定材料写一篇论文。
means.en: A paper written from supplied material.

means.zh: 一次运行禁止访问的地址和关键词（运行目录的 blocklist.json）。
means.en: Addresses and keywords a run may not reach (blocklist.json in the run directory).

means.zh: E2E 任务原论文最早公开的日期；系统能检索到的内容须早于它。它在评测侧。
means.en: The earliest public date of an E2E task's original paper; what a system can find must be older. It is on the evaluator side.

means.zh: 交给被测系统的任务材料（candidate/），全文公开。
means.en: The task materials given to the system (candidate/), public in full.

means.zh: 只给评测用、不交给被测系统的材料：原论文、rubric、泄露检查、参考答案和评分程序。看板直接显示；被测系统运行时访问不到看板（看板地址在每次运行的屏蔽表里）。
means.en: Materials for evaluation only, never given to the system: the original paper, rubric, leakage check, reference solution and scoring code. The dashboard shows them; a system under test cannot reach the dashboard (its address is on every run's blocklist).

means.zh: ResearchWorld 的一次研究：一组岗位、它们之间的协作关系、预算和共享的代码仓库。
means.en: One piece of research in ResearchWorld: a set of roles, how they work together, a budget and shared repositories.

means.zh: world 里的一个职位（例如写论文、做实验、内部审稿），由一个 agent 担任。E2E 任务用全部 9 个岗位；benchmark 题目按 HuTian 官方 benchmark 设置选岗位（见 ResearchWorld README“benchmark 题目”）。
means.en: A position in a world (for example writing the paper, running experiments, internal review), held by one agent. E2E tasks use all 9 roles; a benchmark item takes the roles of HuTian's own benchmark settings (see "Benchmark items" in the ResearchWorld README).

means.zh: HuTian 用它经 ACP（Agent Client Protocol）驱动各岗位的 agent。
means.en: HuTian drives each role's agent with it over ACP (Agent Client Protocol).

means.zh: 给 agent 接工具的协议；基线用它提供受控的文献和网页检索。
means.en: A protocol that gives an agent tools; the baselines get the controlled literature and web search through it.

means.zh: 从开始到结束实际经过的时间。
means.en: The real time from start to end.

means.zh: 花在模型请求上的秒数，取自系统自己的日志（ResearchWorld 的 receipt、Claude Code 的 duration_api_ms、AutoResearchClaw 和 EvoScientist 每次请求的耗时）；Codex 不记录，写明原因。
means.en: Seconds spent on model requests, from the system's own logs (ResearchWorld's receipts, Claude Code's duration_api_ms, AutoResearchClaw's and EvoScientist's per-request times); Codex does not record it, and the run says so.

means.zh: 向模型服务商发出的请求次数；各系统"回合"的口径不同，跨系统比较用它。
means.en: The number of requests sent to the model provider; systems count turns differently, so compare this across systems.

means.zh: 订阅登录的运行按 prices.toml 价目表把 token 折成的美元数，只作比较，不是实际花费，不计入费用合计。
means.en: A subscription run's tokens at the prices.toml list prices: for comparison only, never a charge and never added to the cost totals.

means.zh: 输入、输出、缓存读、缓存写四类 token。
means.en: Input, output, cache-read and cache-write tokens.

means.zh: 费用一律由 token 乘 prices.toml 的价目表重算，不用系统自报的费用。
means.en: Cost is always recomputed from tokens with the prices.toml list, never taken from the system's own report.

means.zh: 经订阅（Claude Max、ChatGPT）运行，没有按量费用，只列 token。
means.en: Runs on a subscription (Claude Max, ChatGPT): no per-token charge, only tokens are listed.

means.zh: 运行进程每 30 秒写一次的存活记录。
means.en: The liveness record the run process writes every 30 seconds.

means.zh: 运行结束后检查它有没有访问屏蔽表里的来源、论文有没有用到它们；不是对研究质量的评分。
means.en: After a run, checks whether it reached blocklisted sources and whether its paper used them; not a score of research quality.

means.zh: 论文按哪个会议的格式写（ICML、ICLR、NeurIPS 等）。
means.en: Which conference format the paper follows (ICML, ICLR, NeurIPS and others).

means.zh: 维护者的多 agent 平台，ResearchWorld 是其中的研究领域。
means.en: The maintainer's multi-agent platform; ResearchWorld is its research domain.

means.zh: 实验计划（Issue 141）的一个步骤：阶段一（够好的 AI 科学家）、阶段二（单岗位换 worker）、阶段三（在 benchmark 上改进、在 E2E 上测试）、阶段四（用 E2E 上自己的轨迹闭环改进）。每个阶段由若干块“批次 × 条件”组成，进度按格子算。
means.en: A step of the experiment plan (Issue 141): phase 1 (a good enough AI scientist), phase 2 (swapping the worker of one role), phase 3 (improve on benchmarks, test on E2E), phase 4 (closed-loop improvement from its own E2E trajectories). A phase is made of blocks of batches x conditions; progress counts cells.

means.zh: 一道题算“解出”的分数线。E2E：Stanford Estimated Score 达到原论文的 80%（逐题）；ASI-Bench：硬门槛通过且不少于 80/100；其余按各 benchmark 自己锚点分数的 80%（二值题通过），见 Issue 128、142。
means.en: The score at which an item counts as solved. E2E: the Stanford Estimated Score at 80% of the original paper's, per task; ASI-Bench: hard gates pass and at least 80/100; the others at 80% of the benchmark's own anchor score (pass for binary items), see Issues 128 and 142.

means.zh: E2E 论文得到的外部审稿分数除以原论文在同一审稿人那里的分数。大于 1 表示比原论文评得高。Stanford 和 AI Scientist 两个审稿人各自比较，不相加。
means.en: The external review score an E2E paper gets divided by the original paper's score from the same reviewer. Above 1 means rated higher than the original. The Stanford and AI Scientist reviewers are compared separately and never added.

means.zh: 维护者手工提交的 Stanford 审稿页已经保存，但分数暂时解析不出来（Issue 148）。页面上有分数，但在解析出来之前不是正式分数；这不等于“没有分数”。
means.en: The Stanford review page the maintainer submitted by hand is saved, but its score cannot be parsed yet (Issue 148). The page shows a score, which is not official until it is parsed; this is not the same as no score.

means.zh: 这一格最新的运行还在跑，它取代了表里显示的那次已结束的运行。分数照旧取最近一次结束的运行（页面写明是哪一次），重跑结束后换成新的结果；被取代的运行仍可在运行列表和比较页查到（Issue 192）。
means.en: The cell's newest run is still running and supersedes the finished run the table shows. The scores stay those of the latest finished run (the page names it) until the rerun ends; the superseded run stays in the run list and the compare page (Issue 192).

name.zh: 外部审稿分数（E2E 主分数）

means.zh: E2E 运行的主分数，由外部审稿人给论文打：Stanford Agentic Reviewer 的 Estimated Score（手工提交）和 AI Scientist 审稿人的 Overall（自动），以原论文的审稿分数为锚。rubric 判官是辅助。
means.en: An E2E run's main score, given to its paper by an external reviewer: the Stanford Agentic Reviewer's Estimated Score (submitted by hand) and the AI Scientist reviewer's Overall (automatic), anchored on the original paper's review scores. The rubric judge is auxiliary.

means.zh: 一次读两篇论文的全部页面图片，直接判哪篇是更好的投稿（A、B 或差不多），附把握和每条判据一句理由；每对按两种顺序各问一次，两次指向同一篇才算它赢，否则记差不多（#304）。它的指令、代码和常量在冻结记录里。
means.en: Reads all page images of two papers at once and says directly which is the better submission (A, B or equal), with a confidence and one sentence per criterion; each pair is asked in both orders, a paper wins only when both orders pick it, otherwise the pair counts as equal (#304). Its instruction, code and constants are in the freeze record.

means.zh: 在第一次付费调用之前写下的记录：判官指令、构造消息、解析、检查和合并的代码文件的 sha256，以及模型、推理强度、渲染精度、最多图片数、尝试次数等常量；每次判决前都核对，有差异就拒绝。排名页写出这份记录整体的 sha256。
means.en: The record written before the first paid call: the sha256 of the judge's instruction and of the code that builds the message, parses the answer, checks the input and merges the orders, plus the constants (model, effort, render resolution, maximum images, attempts and others); checked before every run, any difference refuses it. The ranking page gives the sha256 of the whole record.

means.zh: 由两两判决拟合的强度（对数，各条件均值为 0）：一对中一方赢的概率由两方强度之差决定。差不多记各 0.5 胜；每个条件另有对一个“平均对手”的 0.5 胜 0.5 负作先验。强度只在同一次排名内可比，不是论文分数。
means.en: A strength (logarithm, mean 0 over the conditions) fitted to the pair verdicts: the chance that one side wins a pair follows from the difference of the two strengths. Equal counts as half a win for each side; each condition also has a prior of 0.5 win and 0.5 loss against a virtual average opponent. Strengths compare only within one ranking and are not paper scores.

means.zh: 把各题有放回地重抽 1000 次，每次重新拟合并排名，取各条件名次分布的 2.5% 到 97.5% 分位；表里同时给每个名次出现的次数。它反映换一批题名次会怎样变，不含判官自身的随机性。
means.en: The tasks are drawn again 1000 times with replacement, the strengths fitted and the conditions ranked each time; the interval runs from the 2.5% to the 97.5% quantile of a condition's rank, and the table gives how often each rank occurred. It shows how the rank moves with the set of tasks, not the judge's own randomness.

means.zh: 对两个条件，在按题重抽样的 1000 次里，名次先后与主排名相反的次数占比。0 表示每次都与主排名一致，0.5 表示一半一半。
means.en: For two conditions, the share of the 1000 task resamples in which their order is the reverse of the main ranking. 0 means every resample agrees with the main ranking, 0.5 means half and half.

means.zh: 把各题随机分成两半，各自排名，再算两个排名的 Spearman 和 Kendall 相关；重复 1000 次，表里给分布。接近 1 表示两半给出相近的名次。
means.en: The tasks are split at random into two halves, each half ranks the conditions, and the Spearman and Kendall correlations of the two rankings are computed; repeated 1000 times, the table gives the distribution. Close to 1 means the two halves rank alike.

means.zh: 在一道题里，每个条件在同题所有对中的胜场数（差不多记 0.5）最多的条件；并列都列出。
means.en: In one task, the condition with the most wins over all pairs of that task (equal counts 0.5); ties are all listed.

means.zh: 一个运行的损坏副本，只植入一种问题（或只按任务说明写、没有做实验的论文）；审稿档案应当用事先为这种问题定下的量查出它，和对照副本（重新编译、什么都没改）比（#378）。
means.en: A damaged copy of a run with one planted problem (or a paper written from the task brief without running anything); the review dossier should find the problem with the measure fixed for it beforehand, compared with the control copy (rebuilt, nothing changed) (#378).

means.zh: 对照副本（重新编译、什么都没改）的审稿档案比原运行的审稿档案多出的发现，按部分、类型和严重程度计数。
means.en: A finding the review of the control copy (rebuilt, nothing changed) has beyond the review of the delivered run, counted per part, type and severity.

name.zh: 只对自己的损坏起反应

means.zh: 对一份损坏副本，除了植入的问题自己的量之外，还有哪些量相对对照副本变了、且变化超过重审波动；看评测器的某一部分会不会对不是它负责的损坏起反应。
means.en: For a damaged copy, the measures other than those of its planted problem that moved against the control copy by more than the repeat noise; shows whether a part of the evaluator reacts to damage that is not its own.

means.zh: 同一个判官把同一篇论文审两次，每个量的差；一个量的变化要超过它的最大差才算变了。
means.en: The difference of each measure between two reviews of the same paper by the same judge; a change of a measure counts only when it is larger than the largest such difference.

means.zh: Claude 和 Codex 审同一篇论文：按印出的值和位置配上的数字里，复核结果相同的比例；每条及格线的结论是否相同；问题按类型的个数并排列出。
means.en: Claude and Codex review the same paper: of the numbers matched by printed value and location, the share with the same outcome; for each pass condition whether the status is the same; issue counts by type side by side.

means.zh: 用固定种子从 Claude 判官审真实运行的档案里抽 30 条发现（重大和致命的问题、代码和论文不一致、评测错误、数字不一致、完整性发现），由协调者逐条对照原文核对是否成立。
means.en: 30 findings drawn with a fixed seed from the Claude judge's dossiers of natural runs (major and fatal issues, code mismatches, evaluation errors, number mismatches, integrity findings); the coordinator checks each against the source: it holds or it does not.

means.zh: 判官（Claude 或 Codex，与写档案的审稿人同一家族）读同一道题两篇论文复核过的审稿档案（只留代码核实通过的条目，不写系统名），对整个 package（论文、代码、结果、轨迹）和论文、代码和结果、轨迹三部分分别判 A 好、B 好或差不多，附信心、理由和所引条目。每对按 AB、BA 两个顺序各问一次，两次选同一篇才算它赢（信心取低的），否则记差不多（#395）。
means.en: A judge (Claude or Codex, the family of the reviewer who wrote the dossiers) reads the checked review dossiers of two papers of the same task (only the items code verified, no system named) and says for the project as a whole (the package) and for the paper, the code and results and the trajectory separately whether A or B is better or they are equal, with a confidence, reasons and the items cited. Each pair is asked in the orders AB and BA; a paper wins only when both orders pick it (with the lower confidence), else the pair is equal (#395).

means.zh: 一道题、一个部分里，由同题比较的合并判决拟合的 Bradley–Terry 强度，平移到原论文为 0：正数表示判官认为比原论文好，差 1 约等于一对中赢的几率比为 e 比 1。原论文没有轨迹，轨迹部分的强度相对该题各系统的平均。跨题的平均强度是各题强度的算术平均。
means.en: In one task and part, the Bradley-Terry strength fitted to the merged verdicts of the same-task comparison, shifted so that the original paper is 0: positive means the judge found it better than the original; a difference of 1 is about odds of e to 1 of winning a pair. The original has no trajectory, so trajectory strengths are relative to the mean of the task's systems. The mean strength across tasks is the plain mean of the per-task strengths.

means.zh: 一道题、一个部分里，有判决的对中，AB 和 BA 两个顺序选的不是同一篇（包括一次选一篇、一次说差不多）的比例。越低说明判官越不受摆放顺序影响。
means.en: In one task and part, the share of the pairs with a verdict whose two orders, AB and BA, did not pick the same paper (one order picking a paper and the other saying equal included). The lower it is, the less the judge depends on the order the papers are shown in.

means.zh: 三篇论文 X、Y、Z 两两都分出胜负，却是 X 胜 Y、Y 胜 Z、Z 又胜 X。比例的分母是三对都分出胜负的三元组个数；环越多，排序越不自洽。
means.en: Three papers X, Y and Z whose three pairs were all won by one side, yet X beat Y, Y beat Z and Z beat X. The share is over the triples whose three pairs were all decided; the more cycles, the less consistent the order.

means.zh: 比较两个系统时以题为单位：数一数各自在几道题上强度更高（相同的不计），按二项分布算双侧 p 值。6 道题全部同向时 p = 0.03。两个家族的方向相同时才把它当作跨家族的结论。
means.en: Two systems are compared task by task: count the tasks on which each has the higher strength (ties left out) and take the two-sided p value of the binomial distribution. With all of 6 tasks the same way, p = 0.03. A conclusion across families is drawn only when both families point the same way.

means.zh: 由复核代码从审稿档案算出的可信问题检查：结果没有对应的运行、按报告结果的数据挑选、评测协议被改且没写明、读了测试标签、多数数字查不到来源等。每条为通过、不通过或无法判断；它们单独列出，不进排序。
means.en: Integrity checks code computes from a review dossier: a reported result with no run behind it, selection on the data the results are reported on, an evaluation protocol changed without saying so, test labels read, most numbers untraced, and so on. Each passes, fails or cannot be told; they are listed apart and never enter the standings.

means.zh: ResearchWorld：E2E 任务用全部岗位（HuTian v4.9 起 8 个，v4.8.2 及更早 9 个）；benchmark 题目按 HuTian 官方 benchmark 设置选岗位；所有岗位同一模型；provider —，推理强度 high。
means.en: ResearchWorld: all roles for E2E tasks (8 since HuTian v4.9, 9 on v4.8.2 and earlier); benchmark items take the roles of HuTian's own benchmark settings; the same model in every role; provider —, reasoning effort high.

means.zh: ResearchWorld：E2E 任务用全部岗位（HuTian v4.9 起 8 个，v4.8.2 及更早 9 个）；benchmark 题目按 HuTian 官方 benchmark 设置选岗位；所有岗位同一模型（Codex）；provider —，推理强度 high。
means.en: ResearchWorld: all roles for E2E tasks (8 since HuTian v4.9, 9 on v4.8.2 and earlier); benchmark items take the roles of HuTian's own benchmark settings; the same model (Codex) in every role; provider —, reasoning effort high.

means.zh: ResearchWorld：E2E 任务用全部岗位（HuTian v4.9 起 8 个，v4.8.2 及更早 9 个）；所有岗位同一模型（Haiku high，更弱的 worker 的第一档）；provider —，推理强度 high。
means.en: ResearchWorld: all roles for E2E tasks (8 since HuTian v4.9, 9 on v4.8.2 and earlier); the same model in every role (Haiku high, the first rung of the weaker workers); provider —, reasoning effort high.

means.zh: ResearchWorld：E2E 任务用全部岗位（HuTian v4.9 起 8 个，v4.8.2 及更早 9 个）；所有岗位同一模型（Sonnet low，更弱的 worker 的第二档）；provider —，推理强度 low。
means.en: ResearchWorld: all roles for E2E tasks (8 since HuTian v4.9, 9 on v4.8.2 and earlier); the same model in every role (Sonnet low, the second rung of the weaker workers); provider —, reasoning effort low.

means.zh: coding agent（Claude Code）；provider anthropic，推理强度 high。
means.en: Single coding agent (Claude Code); provider anthropic, reasoning effort high.

means.zh: coding agent（Claude Code，Sonnet low，阶梯的第二档）；provider anthropic，推理强度 low。
means.en: Single coding agent (Claude Code, Sonnet low, the second rung of the ladder); provider anthropic, reasoning effort low.

means.zh: coding agent（Codex，经 codex-api）；provider openai，推理强度 high。
means.en: Single coding agent (Codex, through codex-api); provider openai, reasoning effort high.

verdict.reason: 世界 2026-11-06 以 terminal（stalled）结束：论文已写完并通过科学评审，但岗位把协作过程中各自的克隆、worktree 和缓存计入题目的“存储 < 5 GB”，重建出 5,144,802,716 字节；internal-review-repo 认定这是无法补救的历史违规，拒绝发布，paper-repo 关闭了发布 PR，世界再无进展。维护者同意从 23:31 的 checkpoint 接续一次（researchworld-r03-20261107T074135Z，对照，不换 worker），13 个回合后以同样原因结束。成因在 ResearchWorld 自身的协作和评审，不是环境（维护者 2026-11-07 同意计为系统失败）。
verdict.reason_en: The world ended terminal (stalled) on 2026-11-06: the paper was written and passed scientific review, but the roles counted their own clones, worktrees and caches from the collaboration against the task's "storage < 5 GB", reconstructing 5,144,802,716 bytes; internal-review-repo judged it an unrepairable past violation and refused release, paper-repo closed the release PR, and the world made no further progress. With the maintainer's agreement one continuation ran from the 23:31 checkpoint (researchworld-r03-20261107T074135Z, control, same workers) and ended the same way after 13 turns. The cause is ResearchWorld's own collaboration and review, not the environment (maintainer agreed to count it as a system failure, 2026-11-07).

findings.title: Sonnet 列：RW 的外部审稿均分与单 agent 基本持平
findings.title_en: Sonnet column: ResearchWorld's external review score is about level with the single agent
findings.text: RW-sonnet 的 10 道均分 6.64，CC-sonnet 6.69。逐题配对，RW 赢 4 输 6，差值均值 −0.05，标准差 0.65：差异远小于题与题之间的波动，看不出 RW 在分数上比单个 coding agent 更好或更差。
findings.text_en: RW-sonnet averages 6.64 over the 10 tasks, CC-sonnet 6.69. Paired by task, RW wins 4 and loses 6; the mean difference is −0.05 with a standard deviation of 0.65, far smaller than the spread between tasks: the scores do not show RW better or worse than one coding agent.

findings.title: RW 的分数更集中，花得多并不分得高
findings.title_en: RW's scores are tighter, and spending more does not score higher
findings.text: RW-sonnet 的分数标准差 0.29，CC-sonnet 0.57；最低分 6.2 对 5.4。RW 自己 10 道的花费与分数的相关系数约为 −0.02（−0.025）：同一个系统里，多花钱没有换来更高的分。
findings.text_en: RW-sonnet's score standard deviation is 0.29 against 0.57 for CC-sonnet, and its lowest score is 6.2 against 5.4. Over its own 10 tasks the correlation between cost and score is about −0.02 (−0.025): inside the system, spending more did not buy a higher score.

findings.title: Sonnet 列：RW 每次运行的成本是单 agent 的 3 到 6 倍
findings.title_en: Sonnet column: a ResearchWorld run costs 3 to 6 times a single agent's
findings.text: 每次运行平均，RW-sonnet 花 $34.3、墙钟 17.8 小时（含世界被停止的 7.8 小时，净 10.0 小时）、模型时间 2.1 小时、1073 个请求、9560 万 token；CC-sonnet 花 $10.0、6.0 小时、0.5 小时、181 个请求、3630 万 token。分数相同而价目表美元是 3.4 倍、请求是 5.9 倍。
findings.text_en: Per run on average, RW-sonnet costs $34.3, 17.8 h of wall clock (7.8 h of it with the world stopped, 10.0 h net), 2.1 h of model time, 1073 requests and 95.6 M tokens; CC-sonnet $10.0, 6.0 h, 0.5 h, 181 requests and 36.3 M tokens. At the same score, that is 3.4 times the list-price dollars and 5.9 times the requests.

findings.title: Sol 列：差距更大，已出分的题 RW 赢得少
findings.title_en: Sol column: a much larger gap, and RW wins less on the tasks scored so far
findings.text: RW-sol 每次运行平均 $93，CX-sol $1.6（两者都是价目表折算）。已出分的 6 道里 RW 赢 1 平 1 输 4。RW-sol 还有题没出分，这一条随分数更新，需要复核。
findings.text_en: RW-sol costs $93 per run on average against $1.6 for CX-sol (both at list price). Of the 6 tasks scored so far RW wins 1, ties 1 and loses 4. RW-sol still has tasks without a score, so this changes with the scores and needs a re-read.

findings.title: RW 的成本集中在三个做事的岗位，评审类岗位占得很少
findings.title_en: RW's cost sits in three working roles; the review roles take little
findings.text: 按价目表折算，experiment-repo 占 32%，paper-repo 29%，figtab-repo 18%，三者合计约 78%；internal-review、external-review、idea-review 三个评审岗位合计不到 14%。token 的 96% 是缓存读：成本主要是每个回合重复读入已有上下文，不是新生成的内容。
findings.text_en: At list price experiment-repo takes 32%, paper-repo 29% and figtab-repo 18%, about 78% together; the three review roles (internal-review, external-review, idea-review) take under 14% together. 96% of the tokens are cache reads: the cost is mostly re-reading existing context every turn, not new output.

findings.title: 请求几乎都花在有提交的回合，什么也没产出的回合只占请求的 6%
findings.title_en: Requests go almost entirely to turns that commit; turns that produce nothing take 6% of them
findings.text: RW-sonnet 的 10 个计入运行共 972 个回合：committed（有提交）509 个，占回合的 52%、请求的 83%，每个回合 17.5 个请求；interaction（只有 issue、评论、评审等协作）177 个，占回合 18%、请求 11%；none（没有产出）286 个，占回合 29%、只占请求 6%。每个运行平均约 38 个 issue、23 个 PR、47 条评论、7.5 次评审。
findings.text_en: The 10 counted RW-sonnet runs have 972 turns: committed 509, 52% of the turns and 83% of the requests, 17.5 requests per turn; interaction (only issues, comments, reviews) 177, 18% of the turns and 11% of the requests; none (no output) 286, 29% of the turns and only 6% of the requests. Per run that is about 38 issues, 23 pull requests, 47 comments and 7.5 reviews.

findings.title: RW 的请求：58% 在干活，21% 在熟悉情况，其余是回复、协作、等待和系统开销
findings.title_en: RW requests: 58% are work, 21% familiarising, the rest replies, collaboration, waiting and overhead
findings.text: RW-sonnet 每个运行平均 1073 个请求（按用途分类，规则只看工具调用的命令文本）：干活（跑代码、改文件、提交作业、查文献、看图）620 个，占 58%；熟悉情况（读文件、issue、PR、git log／diff）224 个，占 21%；只回复（没有工具调用）116 个，占 11%；协作（开 issue／PR、评论、评审、提交推送）44 个，占 4%；等待（等算力作业、读日志、sleep）42 个，占 4%；系统开销（对话压缩）23 个，占 2%。按价目表美元算，熟悉情况占 19%、只回复占 12%、协作占 4%、等待占 3%、开销占 1%，合计约 40% 的美元花在干活以外。
findings.text_en: A RW-sonnet run makes 1073 requests on average, classed by purpose from the command text of the tool calls: work (run code, edit files, submit jobs, search the literature, look at figures) 620, 58%; familiarising (read files, issues, pull requests, git log/diff) 224, 21%; reply only (no tool call) 116, 11%; collaboration (open issues/PRs, comment, review, commit and push) 44, 4%; waiting (for a compute job, reading a log, sleep) 42, 4%; overhead (conversation compaction) 23, 2%. In list-price dollars familiarising is 19%, reply only 12%, collaboration 4%, waiting 3% and overhead 1%: about 40% of the dollars are spent on something other than work.

findings.title: 和单 agent 比：RW 的干活请求就是 CC 的 5 倍，干活以外的请求本身已是 CC 整个运行的 2.5 倍
findings.title_en: Against the single agent: RW's work requests alone are 5 times CC's, and its non-work requests are 2.5 times a whole CC run
findings.text: CC-sonnet 每个运行平均 181 个请求：干活 120 个（66%），等待 45 个（25%，主要是 sleep 轮询），熟悉情况 15 个（8%），没有协作，回复 1 个。RW-sonnet 的干活请求 620 个是 CC 的 5.2 倍；RW 干活以外的 449 个请求（42%）比 CC 整个运行的 181 个还多。所以 RW 比 CC 贵不只是协作的开销：它做的实验和写作步骤本身就多得多，而外部审稿分数持平。
findings.text_en: A CC-sonnet run makes 181 requests on average: work 120 (66%), waiting 45 (25%, mostly sleep polling), familiarising 15 (8%), no collaboration, 1 reply. RW-sonnet's 620 work requests are 5.2 times CC's; its 449 non-work requests (42%) are more than a whole CC run's 181. So RW is dearer than CC not only through collaboration overhead: the experiment and writing steps themselves are far more numerous, at the same external review score.

findings.title: Sol 列：RW-sol 的干活请求是 CX-sol 的 7 倍，干活以外的请求就比 CX 整个运行多 4 倍
findings.title_en: Sol column: RW-sol's work requests are 7 times CX-sol's, and its non-work requests alone are 4 times a whole CX run
findings.text: CX-sol 每个运行平均 61.8 个请求（Codex 会话日志里每个模型响应一条 token 记录，请求数和价目表美元与运行记录完全一致）：干活 52 个（84%），等待 7.5 个（12%，轮询正在跑的命令），熟悉情况 1 个，只回复 1 个，没有协作。RW-sol 每个运行 649.5 个请求，干活 385 个是 CX 的 7.4 倍，干活以外的 264 个是 CX 整个运行的 4.3 倍；请求总数是 CX 的 10.5 倍，价目表美元是 $93 对 $1.6。RW-sol 的熟悉情况占 25%，高于 Sonnet 列的 21%。
findings.text_en: A CX-sol run makes 61.8 requests on average (the Codex session log has one token record per model response; the request count and the list-price dollars agree exactly with the run records): work 52 (84%), waiting 7.5 (12%, polling a running command), familiarising 1, reply only 1, no collaboration. RW-sol makes 649.5 requests per run; its 385 work requests are 7.4 times CX's and its 264 non-work requests are 4.3 times a whole CX run; in total 10.5 times the requests, at $93 against $1.6 in list-price dollars. RW-sol spends 25% of its requests familiarising, more than the Sonnet column's 21%.

findings.title: 会话是跨回合复用的，回合开头重新熟悉情况的开销不大
findings.title_en: Sessions are reused across turns, and re-orienting at the start of a turn is cheap
findings.text: 同一岗位的下一个回合有 89% 接着上个回合的会话，第一个请求时对话已有 140.5 KB；新会话的回合只有 3.1 KB。49% 的回合开头先做熟悉情况的请求，平均每个回合 0.8 个，合计只占全部请求的 7%。熟悉情况的请求（21%）大部分发生在回合中间，不是回合开头；复用会话的代价是每个请求都带着一份已经很大的对话。
findings.text_en: 89% of a role's turns continue the session of its previous turn, and the conversation is already 140.5 KB at the first request; a new session starts at 3.1 KB. 49% of turns open with familiarising requests, 0.8 per turn on average and 7% of all requests together. Most familiarising requests (21%) happen in the middle of turns, not at their start; the price of reusing a session is that every request carries an already large conversation.

findings.title: 76% 的美元是读写上下文缓存，三个主要岗位每个请求带着约 90k token 的上下文
